name: Docker Studio
description: A graphical client for the Docker engine: a live dashboard of resource use and what needs attention, containers grouped by Compose stack with their logs, files, stats and a shell, images with their layers and a run form, volumes, networks, stacks with their service map, builds with their steps, and AI that diagnoses failures and writes Dockerfiles. Every operation runs the docker program without a shell.

commands.title: Docker Studio: open
commands.description: Open Docker Studio, on a section when one is named.

commands.title: Docker Studio: refresh
commands.description: Read the engine and every list again.
